description: Waffle charts: for each of three reasons (companionship, mental health, relaxation), two 10 by 10 grids show how many of every 100 dog owners and cat owners gave that reason, Animal Medicines Australia survey 2025.

signals.name: colorMuted
signals.description: Colour: the dark grey colour of small text: labels and notes. This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-muted in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorHeading
signals.description: Colour: the dark blue colour of chart titles and reason names. This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-heading in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorBorder
signals.description: Colour: light grey, used for the empty squares. This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-border in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetDogs
signals.description: Colour: the colour for dogs (amber). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-dogs in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetCats
signals.description: Colour: the colour for cats (plum). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-cats in css/style.css.

signals.name: fontHeading
signals.description: Font: the fancy title font (DM Serif Display). This is only a backup; the real font comes from --font-heading in css/style.css.

signals.name: fontBody
signals.description: Font: the plain font for all other text (Fira Sans). This is only a backup; the real font comes from --font-body in css/style.css.

signals.name: width
signals.description: Measured by the loader from the chart card.

signals.name: narrow
signals.description: True on narrow screens: the three reasons stack instead of sitting side by side.

signals.name: groupWidth
signals.description: Room for one reason: the whole width when stacked, one third side by side.

signals.name: petGap
signals.description: Space between the dog grid and the cat grid of one reason.

signals.name: step
signals.description: Distance from one square to the next. Two grids of ten squares must fit in each reason's room.

signals.name: gridSize
signals.description: Width and height of one 10 by 10 grid (squares have a 2-pixel gap).

signals.name: gridTop
signals.description: Space above each grid for the reason name and the two pet labels.

signals.name: rowHeight
signals.description: Height of one stacked reason on a narrow screen.

signals.name: noteY
signals.description: Where the note starts: under the last row of grids.

signals.name: height
signals.description: How tall the whole chart is: the grids plus the two-line note.

text.signal: narrow ? ['Companionship draws', 'about half of owners'] : 'Companionship draws about half of owners'

subtitle.signal: narrow ? ['Of every 100 owners, how many gave', 'each reason for getting their pet, 2025'] : 'Of every 100 owners, how many gave each reason for getting their pet, 2025. One square = one owner in 100.'

data.name: shares

transform.description: Keep the three reasons that dog and cat owners share.
Which reason group (0, 1 or 2), left to right or top to bottom.
Which grid within the group: dogs first, cats second.
Direct label, so the exact number never needs counting.

data.description: Static layout, data or appearance for this part of the chart.

data.name: cells

transform.description: One entry for each of the 100 squares in a grid.
Turn each share into 100 square rows, numbered 0 to 99.
Squares fill row by row from the top left until they reach the percentage.

data.description: 100 squares for each pet and reason.

transform.description: One row per reason, for the group headings.

marks.description: Reason name above each pair of grids.
Direct label above each grid, in the pet's colour: for example '56 in 100 dog owners'.

tooltip.signal: {'Pet type': datum.species, 'Reason': datum.reason, 'Owners giving this reason': datum.percent + '%', 'Owners surveyed': format(datum.sample_n, ',.0f'), 'Each square': 'One percentage point', 'Survey year': 2025}

marks.name: waffleLabels
squares
marks.description: The waffle squares: coloured squares are owners who gave the reason; pale squares are owners who did not.

tooltip.signal: {'Pet type': datum.species, 'Reason': datum.reason, 'Owners giving this reason': datum.percent + '%', 'Owners surveyed': format(datum.sample_n, ',.0f'), 'Each square': 'One percentage point', 'Survey year': 2025}

text.signal: narrow ? ['These answers describe hopes, not measured health benefits.', 'Owners could give several reasons, so grids do not add up.'] : ['These answers describe hopes, not measured health benefits.', 'Owners could give several reasons, so the grids do not add up to 100.']

usermeta.codeGuide: Signals set the responsive layout and theme. Data transforms derive values; scales map them to positions and colours; marks draw the chart.

scales.colour: Pet colour, shared with every other chart: dogs amber, cats plum.
